P.text: battleElo calls Elo.ratingChange(eloB, eloA, ...) to obtain change and negative for one party after a single battle, then applies them to update simulated eloA and eloB
P.evidence_quote: This function calls the `ratingChange` function from the external library `Elo.sol` to obtain the rating change amount (`change`) for one party and a direction flag (`negative`) after a single battle.

I.text: When negative is true, eloB should decrease by change and eloA should increase by change; when negative is false, eloA should decrease and eloB should increase
I.evidence_quote: In this scenario (`negative = true`), the correct logic should be to decrease `eloB` by `change` (`eloB -= change`) and simultaneously increase `eloA` by `change` (`eloA += change`).

V.text: The code instead executes eloA -= change and eloB += change when negative is true, and eloA += change and eloB -= change when negative is false, inverting rating adjustment direction
V.evidence_quote: However, the current code executes `eloA -= change` and `eloB += change`.
